crossRefs.note: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
“Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,
He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on…
Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of…
Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh…
at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled…
Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem…
He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun…

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

translations.web: As I made my journey, and came close to Damascus, about noon, suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
translations.bsb: About noon as I was approaching Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and drew nigh unto Damascus, about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
